**All three sites ran normally this week; one supplier delivery is late.**

## Key figures

| Measure | This week | Last week | Change |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| Orders shipped | 1,284 | 1,197 | +7 % |
| On-time delivery | 96.2 % | 97.0 % | −0.8 pt |
| Open support tickets | 41 | 58 | −17 |
| Returns | 23 | 25 | −2 |

## Checks

- [x] Backups finished every night
- [x] Payroll file sent to the bank on Thursday
- [x] Fire doors inspected in the north warehouse
- [ ] Packaging supplier confirms the new delivery date

> [!WARNING]
> The packaging delivery planned for Wednesday has not arrived. Stock lasts until next Friday. I will ask the supplier again on Monday morning.

## Details

The rise in shipped orders comes from the autumn promotion, which ends on Sunday. On-time delivery dropped because two courier routes were cancelled on Tuesday; both ran again from Wednesday.

Support cleared the backlog from the billing change. The remaining tickets are ordinary questions with no common cause.
